prompt: Trong mặt phẳng <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, điểm <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> nằm trên đường tròn nào sau đây?
solution: Ta có <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn></mrow></semantics></math> nên điểm <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> nằm trên đường tròn <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn></mrow></semantics></math>.
